name: jjf-tools
description: The Jumpin' Json Flush database design plugin, distributed as a zip archive over HTTPS.

plugins.name: jjf
plugins.description: Edit and validate jjf database design JSON, then regenerate the Excel design document from it. Can also build the JSON from a PostgreSQL or MySQL schema dump, draw it as an SVG ER diagram, and write it out as a PostgreSQL or MySQL DDL script. Requires the jjf CLI on PATH.
